whenToUse: Counting down to a launch, a registration opening, an event start or a sale ending.
Marketing pages and banners that switch to other content once the time is up.
avoidWhen: A service-level deadline with at-risk and breached states — use sla-timer.
Logging elapsed work time — use time-tracker.
A date that is far away or does not need a ticking clock — show a formatted date.
a11y: role="timer" with one aria-label sentence at minute precision (seconds only in the last minute); the digits are aria-hidden, so the ticking never floods a screen reader.
